seo.title: Privacy Policy (Draft) | RNC Landscaping
seo.description: How RNC Landscaping handles personal information from quote requests and emails, including cookieless analytics. Draft for legal review before launch.

lede: Draft for legal review. This page has not yet been reviewed by a lawyer and must not be relied on as final.

sections.heading: Who we are
body: [LEGAL NAME], operating as RNC Landscaping, [ADDRESS]. Privacy questions: [EMAIL].

sections.heading: What we collect
body: When you request a quote, the form writes an email for you to send from your own email app. It contains what you enter: the services you need, your municipality, details about the property or job, your timing, your name and how you would like us to reply, plus your phone number if you ask us to call or text. Because you send it, it also carries your email address and anything you add or attach before sending.
If your email app does not open, the form offers Gmail and Outlook.com links. They open your request in that service, and that service's own privacy terms apply.
This website does not send or store what you type into the quote form, and we do not ask for payment information on this website.

sections.heading: Settings saved on your device
body: If you change the Dark theme or Animations setting, your browser remembers the choice in its local storage (rnc-theme and rnc-motion) so the next page looks the same.

While you fill in the quote form, your browser keeps a draft in its session storage (rnc-quote-draft), so the draft is still there if you come back to the page. The browser deletes it when you close the tab.
These settings stay on your device. They are not cookies, and they are never sent to us. Clearing this site's data in your browser removes them.

sections.heading: Why we collect it
body: To respond to your request, prepare a quote, schedule a site visit and carry out work you agree to. We do not sell personal information or use it for unrelated marketing without your consent.

sections.heading: Consent
body: By sending us a request, you agree that we may use the details in it to respond. You can withdraw consent at any time by contacting [EMAIL], subject to legal or contractual limits.

sections.heading: Where it is stored
body: Quote requests and messages arrive in our business email account. Our email and website hosting providers may store data outside Canada, including in the United States, where it may be subject to local laws. A list of these providers is available on request.

sections.heading: Analytics and cookies
body: We use Plausible Analytics, a cookieless analytics service, to count visits in aggregate. It also counts a few actions, such as opening the quote email or pressing a Call button, without recording anything you typed. It does not use tracking cookies or collect personal information that identifies you. This site does not set tracking cookies.

sections.heading: How long we keep it
body: We keep quote requests only as long as needed for the purposes above and for our business records.

sections.heading: How we protect it
body: We limit access to people who need it and use reasonable security safeguards with our service providers.

sections.heading: Your rights
body: You may ask to see or correct the personal information we hold about you. Contact [EMAIL]. If you're not satisfied, you may contact the Office of the Information and Privacy Commissioner for British Columbia.
